pie: déh₃t wĺ̥kʷos pórḱōy bʰoydʰéh₂m. ne te h₁édoh₂. pórḱos gʷétes. bʰebʰóydʰh₂e nu Hrunépt wĺ̥kʷos bʰoydʰéh₂m tóm-kʷe gʷr̥h₃ét. h₁yód kénketi tósyo bʰoydʰéh₂ Hrumptór.
english: The wolf gave the piglet a pledge: "I will not eat you." The piglet said: "I am confident." Then the wolf broke the pledge and devoured him. If he is hungry, his pledge breaks.

pie: awis, yasmin warnā na ā ast, dadarka akwams, tam, wāgʰam garum wagʰantam, tam, bʰāram magʰam, tam, manum āku bʰarantam.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: sth₂éh₁yet kápros h₂ḱméni nu tóm kʷḱónts wĺ̥kʷos wéwket. kápre h₂éǵrom ní gʷh₂dʰí. tód h₁wésu h₁ésti. tód ne spéḱyesi. spéḱyesi me nu linékʷt wĺ̥kʷos. tósyo wékʷos h₁wésu h₁ésti tósyo-kʷe ḱérdih₁ kénketi.
english: A goat stood on a stone. The wolf, catching sight of him, said: "Goat, go down to the field! It is good." "You do not look at it. You look at me." Then the wolf left. His word is good, and his heart is hungry.

pie: lm̥bʰént h₂ŕ̥tḱos-kʷe wĺ̥kʷos-kʷe h₃érō skʷálom nu h₂ŕ̥tḱos h₂éǵt. só moy h₁ésti. h₁eǵ tewh₂sós h₁ésmi. skʷtā́m wĺ̥kʷos-kʷe h₃érō. túH tewh₂sós h₁ési wé-kʷe ml̥dúh₁ h₁swós nu linkʷtā́m. ish₁rós sléh₂gʷt ml̥dúes-kʷe kénkonti.
english: A bear, a wolf and an eagle grasped a large fish. The bear said: "It is mine. I am strong." The wolf and the eagle said: "You are strong, and we two are weak." Then the two left. The strong takes, and the weak go hungry.

pie: ḱémh₂t h₁éḱwos légʰt-kʷe. dʰéǵʰom me méh₂ter sl̥h₂gʷdʰí. sh₂wéns kʷékʷlom bʰérom nu sléh₂gʷt dʰéǵʰōm tóm. dʰéǵʰōm mórtōm méh₂tēr h₁ésti.
english: A horse grew tired and lay down. "Mother Earth, take me! I carried the wheel of the sun." Then the earth took him. The earth is the mother of mortals.

pie: h₁ést h₂wéys nisdós dréwi nu h₂éngʷʰis nisdóm próti sérpet nu bʰéyh₂t séh₂ gʷétet-kʷe. h₃éron me ḱléwse. h₂éngʷʰis moy nisdóm próti sérpeti nu tā́m h₂wisónts h₃érō gʷémt h₂éngʷʰim-kʷe h₁épt. ḱléwt ḱéywos tóm h₁yós HréwdHti.
english: A bird's nest was in the tree. Then a snake crept toward the nest. She grew afraid and said: "Eagle, listen to me! A snake is creeping toward my nest!" The eagle, hearing her, came and seized the snake. The friend hears the one who cries out.

pie: h₁épt h₃érō h₂ówim úd-kʷe gʷéh₂t nu widét h₂éwis tód. h₁eǵ-ge moysóm sléh₂gʷoh₂ nu tóm sléh₂gʷt nu h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ tā́m kapyét lémbʰt-kʷe poh₂imḗn tā́m nu séh₂ wókʷet. h₁eǵ h₃érō ne h₁ésmi. h₁yéh₂ h₃érō ne h₁ésti h₁épt poh₂imḗn tā́m.
english: An eagle seized a sheep and went up. The bird saw this. "I will indeed seize a ram!" Then she took it. Then the wool held her, and the shepherd caught her. Then she said: "I am not an eagle!" She who is not an eagle, the shepherd seizes.

pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: duktā́m dwóh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ kʷékʷlom. kʷékʷlos h₂éǵt. h₂nérm̥ wéǵʰoh₂. sékʷt h₁éḱwos. déwkmi te. yugóm wéwket. tóh₁ yunégti nu h₂nḗr h₁éḱwoh₁ léh₁t nu stnéh₂t kʷékʷlos. h₁yód h₁éḱwos ne déwkti kʷékʷlos stnéh₂ti.
english: Two horses pulled the wheel. The wheel said: "I carry the man." The horse said: "I pull you." The yoke said: "I join the two." Then the man let the two horses go. Then the wheel stood still. If the horse does not pull, the wheel stands.

pie: gʷíh₃wet h₂ówis h₂éǵroy ḱwṓ-kʷe tā́m péh₂st nu kʷéḱt wĺ̥kʷos tā́m tósyeh₂ey-kʷe mléwHt. h₂ówey toy ḱwṓ ḱéywos ne h₁ésti. tóm h₂epó h₂éǵe ḱéywos-kʷe toy h₁ésoh₂ nu séh₂ tóm h₂epó h₂éǵet nu wókʷet séh₂. só kúdʰe h₁ésti? nu tā́m gʷr̥h₃ét. h₁yéh₂ ḱwónm̥ h₂epó h₂éǵeti séh₂ wĺ̥kʷom h₂életi.
english: A sheep lived in the field, and a dog guarded her. A wolf caught sight of her. He said to her: "Sheep, the dog is not your friend. Drive him away, and I will be your friend." Then she drove him away. Then she said: "Where is he?" Then he devoured her. The one who drives the dog away feeds the wolf.

pie: h₁ludʰét dʰǵʰúHm̥ bʰéronts ḱwṓ wédos nu ḱwónm̥ wédni spéḱyet. dʰǵʰúHm̥ moy toy dh₃dʰí nu HréwdHt nu h₃sléydʰt só wódr̥ h₁h₃sés wédos-kʷe tóm h₂pó wéǵʰet. h₁yós polh₁ú h₂isḱéti swóm tósmey néḱt.
english: A dog carrying a fish came to the water. Then he looked at a dog in the water. "Give me your fish!" Then he cried out. Then it slipped from the mouth into the water, and the water transported it off. Whoever seeks much, his own vanishes.

pie: h₁ludʰét h₂éngʷʰis wódr̥ márkōy-kʷe gʷétet. wódr̥ me pér wéǵʰe. h₂éngʷʰey te bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. ne te moréyōh₂. h₁yód te moréyōh₂ méroh₂ nu wéǵʰet márkos tóm nu h₂éngʷʰis tóm moréyet mr̥tā́m-kʷe. h₁yós bʰérontm̥ tóm gʷʰénti só mért.
english: A snake came to the water and said to the horse: "Transport me through the water!" "Snake, I fear you." "I will not kill you. If I kill you, I shall die." Then the horse transported him. Then the snake killed him, and the two died. Whoever kills his carrier dies.

pie: wésto wĺ̥kʷos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₂éǵrom-kʷe wéyḱt nu wérh₁yet tóm kʷḱónts poh₂imḗn. h₂ówis h₁uséwih₂ h₁ésti. tā́m kʷsépi pékʷōh₂ nu poh₂imḗn tóm moréyet tóm-kʷe pékʷet. h₁yós tā́m h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wéstor poh₂imḗn tóm moréyeti.
english: A wolf wore wool and went into the field. The shepherd, catching sight of him, said: "The sheep is good! At night I will cook her." Then the shepherd killed him and cooked him. Whoever wears that wool, the shepherd kills.

pie: tód ḱeḱluwṓs h₂ówis h₂aǵróm bʰuged.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: dr̥mént HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs h₂éǵroy nu tóns widónts h₃érō tóybʰos sékʷt. h₁éḱwōs ǵʰémi h₁ité h₁eǵ-kʷe upér h₁éymi. h₃éron ní gʷm̥sḱé dr̥mdʰí-kʷe nu gʷm̥sḱét ní ne-kʷe drémt. h₁yós dyéwi méǵh₂s h₁ésti só ǵʰémi méǵh₂s ne h₁ésti.
english: Swift horses ran in the field. The eagle, seeing them, said to them: "Horses, you go on the earth, and I go above." "Eagle, come down and run!" Then he came down and did not run. He who is great in the sky is not great on the earth.

pie: stunédt h₂ŕ̥tḱos h₁éḱwom h₂éǵrōd nu h₁éḱwos h₂nérm̥ h₁r̥sḱét. h₂nér me h₂ŕ̥tḱos h₁éǵʰs h₂éǵeti. tóm h₁éǵʰs h₁l̥h₂dʰí. sékʷt wiHrós. yugóm sl̥h₂gʷdʰí tóm-kʷe h₁éǵʰs h₁élh₂oh₂ nu h₁éḱwos yugóm sléh₂gʷt nu wiHrós tóm yéwgt h₁élh₂t-kʷe h₂ŕ̥tḱom h₁éǵʰs. sh₁dʰí me. ne te séh₁oh₂. h₁yós h₂nérm̥ h₁r̥sḱéti só yugóm bʰéreti.
english: A bear pushed a horse out of the field. The horse went to a man. "Man, the bear is driving me out! Drive him out." The man said: "Take the yoke, and I will drive him out." Then the horse took the yoke. The man harnessed him and drove the bear out. "Let me go!" "I will not let you go." Whoever goes to the man carries the yoke.

pie: h₁épt h₂ŕ̥tḱos múHsm̥. múHs sékʷt. l̥h₁dʰí me. h₁eǵ ml̥dús h₁ésmi túH-kʷe tewh₂sós h₁ési. h₁yód me séh₁esi spéroh₂ te nu léh₁t tóm nu wiHrṓs sh₂imónm̥ h₂ŕ̥tḱom péri Hih₁ként nu h₂ŕ̥tḱos HréwdHt nu drémt tóm ḱl̥wónts múHs tóm sh₂imónm̥-kʷe skinédt. spérs me. ml̥dús tewh₂sóm spért.
english: A bear seized a mouse. The mouse said: "Let me go! I am weak and you are strong. If you let me go, I will free you." The bear let him go. Then men threw a cord around the bear. The bear cried out. The mouse, hearing him, ran to him and cut the cord. "You freed me!" The weak frees the strong.

pie: gʷr̥h₃ét h₁ógʷʰis táwrom nu h₃érō h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. wérh₁t h₂éwis tósmey. h₃éron toy h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm kʷíh₁ h₁ésti? tóm gʷʰénm̥. h₁yós h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰénti ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos tósmey h₁ésti.
english: A serpent devoured an aurochs. Then the eagle slew the serpent. A bird said to him: "Eagle, how is your name famous?" "I slew him." Whoever slays the serpent, his fame is imperishable.

pie: h₁itā́m ḱéywoh₁ h₁iméni nu h₂ŕ̥tḱos tóh₁ gʷémt nu stéygʰome sḿ̥teros dréwi ḱéywos-kʷe légʰt nu h₂ŕ̥tḱos h₂énti h₁ért léytt-kʷe nu gʷéh₂t sḿ̥teros ní. kʷíd toy h₂ŕ̥tḱos wéwket? mléwHt moy. tóm mē sékʷeth₂e. h₁yós te linékʷti só ḱéywos ne h₁ésti.
english: Two friends were going along the way. A bear came to them. One of the two climbed into a tree, and the friend lay down. The bear came near and went away. Then one of the two came down. "What did the bear say to you?" "He said to me: 'Do not follow him.'" A friend who leaves you is not a friend.

pie: ḱélet h₁yégos wódr̥ ǵʰyémi nu kápros h₁yégoy stéygʰet nu gʷémt márkos tód. kápros tósmey h₂éǵt. márke h₁yégoy mē gʷéh₂s. tód ish₁róm ne h₁ésti. kápre h₁eǵ stuh₂rós h₁ésmi tód-kʷe ish₁róm h₁ésti nu tósmi gʷéh₂t nu bʰidtó h₁yégos márkos-kʷe wódr̥ séngʷt. h₁yégos ml̥dúm tetólh₂e bʰidtó-kʷe tód ish₁róm Hn̥dʰí.
english: In winter ice covered the water. A goat walked on the ice. Then a horse came to it. The goat said to him: "Horse, do not go on the ice! It is not strong." "Goat, I am strong, and it is strong." Then he went on it. The ice split, and the horse fell into the water. The ice holds the weak, but under the strong it splits.

pie: h₁regʷesyét h₂isḱét-kʷe h₁ógʷʰis pórḱom kʷsépi. pórḱos moldʰéyet. h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter gʷm̥yé. ḱunéy h₁ógʷʰim woydéye nu léwkt nu HréwdHt h₁ógʷʰim kʷḱónts ḱwṓ nu h₁ógʷʰis bʰéwgt. h₁yós kʷsépi h₁éyti só h₂usési bʰéwgt.
english: It was getting dark. At night a serpent sought a piglet. The piglet prayed: "Dawn, daughter of Sky, come! Show the serpent to the dog!" Then it grew bright. The dog, catching sight of the serpent, cried out, and the serpent fled. Whoever goes by night flees at dawn.

pie: gʷíh₃wetām dʰǵʰúHs-kʷe skʷálos wédesi nu sóh₂wl̥ wédos h₂sowséyet. wérh₁t dʰǵʰúHs tósmey. skʷále h₂ékʷeh₂ lelóykʷe. móri gʷéh₂omes. swóy wédni tḱéymi nu dʰǵʰúHs móri snéh₂t nu skʷálos mért. h₁yód h₂ékʷeh₂ lelóykʷe h₁yós tḱéyti mért só.
english: A fish and a sheatfish lived in the water. Then the sun dried the water. The fish said to him: "Sheatfish, the water is gone. Let us go to the sea!" "I dwell in my own water." Then the fish swam to the sea. And the sheatfish died. If the water is gone, he who dwells dies.

pie: wéwket h₂ówis swéh₂ey dʰugh₂tréy. dʰúgh₂ter wódr̥ kʷsépi mē gʷéh₂s. wl̥kʷíh₂s h₂én stestóh₂e. nu dʰugh₂tḗr swéh₂m méh₂term̥ ne h₂wéyst nu tód h₁r̥sḱét nu lémbʰt wl̥kʷíh₂s tā́m nu dʰugh₂tḗr gʷétet. méh₂ter me ḱléwse nu wl̥kʷíh₂s tā́m gʷr̥h₃ét. spért méh₂tr̥s wékʷos tā́m h₁yéh₂ tód h₂wéyst.
english: A sheep said to her daughter: "Daughter, do not go to the water at night! A she-wolf is standing there." The daughter did not hear her own mother. She went to it. The she-wolf seized her. Then the daughter said: "Mother, listen to me!" Then the she-wolf devoured her. The mother's word frees the daughter who hears it.

pie: ḱéyto ḱwṓ h₂élbʰiti nu gʷówes gʷowsth₂óm h₁ludʰónt. wérh₁yont tósmey. ḱwón h₂élbʰit ne h₁édsi. h₂élbʰit nos dh₃dʰí. gʷówes h₂epó litté. h₂élbʰit wos ne dédeh₃mi nu tóm h₁eǵʰ stundént h₂élbʰit-kʷe h₂ḱh₃ént. h₁yós ne h₁édti ne-kʷe dédeh₃ti só h₁eǵʰ stundtór.
english: A dog lay on the barley. Then the cattle came to the cow-stall. They said to him: "Dog, you do not eat the barley. Give us the barley!" "Go away, cattle! I do not give you the barley." Then they pushed him out and ate up the barley. He who does not eat and does not give is pushed out.

pie: ḱéyto sh₂imṓ h₁iméni nu márkos tóm spéḱyet bʰéyh₂t-kʷe. mléwHt. h₂éngʷʰis h₁ésti nu bʰéwgt nu ḱéyto h₂éngʷʰis h₁iméni nu márkos h₂éngʷʰim ne kʷéḱt tóm-kʷe gʷémt nu h₂éngʷʰis tóm gʷʰént. h₁yós sh₂imónm̥ bʰebʰóyh₂e só h₂éngʷʰim ne widét.
english: A cord lay on the way. The horse looked at it and was afraid. He said: "A snake!" and fled. Then a snake lay on the way. The horse did not catch sight of the snake and came upon it. Then the snake killed him. He who trembles at a cord does not see the snake.

pie: píph₃et wl̥kʷíh₂s h₂ékʷeh₂m upér moysós-kʷe Hn̥dʰí píph₃et. bʰéh₂t séh₂ tósmey. h₂ékʷeh₂m moy píph₃esi. h₂ékʷeh₂ h₁mé twéd h₁éyti. tód péruti píph₃es. péruti ne gʷíh₃wom. nu toy moy ph₂tḗr h₂ékʷeh₂m píph₃et nu gʷr̥h₃ét tóm. wékʷos kénkontey wĺ̥kʷōy h₁ésti.
english: A she-wolf drank water above, and a ram drank below. She said to him: "You drink my water!" "The water goes from you to me." "Last year you drank it." "Last year I did not live." "Then your father drank my water." Then she devoured him. A hungry wolf has a word.

pie: sth₂éh₁yont kʷetwóres gʷówes dréwi Hn̥dʰí nu h₁ógʷʰih₁ tóns spéḱyet. gʷówes moy wos h₁óynom dédh₃te. wéy stesth₂mé h₁óynom-kʷe toy ne dédh₃mes nu linékʷt nu h₁éyt h₁óynos wédos gʷéwbʰos nu h₁ógʷʰis tóm lémbʰt gʷr̥h₃ét-kʷe. h₁ógʷʰis tóm gʷʰénti h₁yós gʷéwbʰos linékʷti.
english: Four cattle stood under a tree. A serpent looked at them. "Cattle, give me one of you!" "We stand, and we do not give you one." Then he left. Then one went from the cattle to the water. Then the serpent grasped him and devoured him. The serpent kills the one who leaves the cattle.

pie: légʰyet h₂ŕ̥tḱos ǵʰyémi nu h₁yégos tinéh₁t. wókʷet h₂éwis dréwi. bʰudʰdʰí. tód tinéh₁ti nu bʰéwdʰt h₂éǵt-kʷe. kénkoh₂ nu stéh₂t. h₁yód h₁yégos tinéh₁ti h₂ŕ̥tḱos bʰéwdʰt.
english: In winter a bear was lying down. Then the ice melted. A bird said in the tree: "Wake up! The ice is melting." Then he woke and said: "I am hungry." Then he stood up. When the ice melts, the bear wakes.
